about: Aphex Twin - Actium (Selected Ambient Works 85-92), from the official album master's stems: transcribed drums (kick tuned C#2 for the first 42 s), a bass guide re-pitched against the bass stem in a detuned-saw voice (4-pole LP) matched to the stem with audition.py (the old triangle only in 428-436.5 s), a dark plucked synth for the 'other' part, and a steady high drum texture measured in the drum stem. Master: section level, band width, edge-section EQ and contour rides fitted to the record.

actium-bass.about: Actium r12: brighter detuned-saw bass (4-pole LP 450 Hz) matched to the bass stem centroid/width with audition.py.

actium-tone.about: Actium r12: dark plucked synth matched to the 'other' stem (centroid, ~220 ms decay) with audition.py.

actium-air.about: Song-local steady high drum texture measured in Actium's drum stem (5-16 kHz), not a shared tape/noise model.

actium-bass-tri.about: Sampleless steady bass guide: same-key triangle and sine, no sampled audio or invented octave-sub; pitches are spectral hypotheses.
